description_en: Queries a real-time log delivery project
description_zh: 调用ListDcdnRealTimeDeliveryProject查询用户开通的项目信息
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn list-dcdn-real-time-delivery-project --business-type cdn_log_access_l1 --domain-name example.com --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDcdnRealTimeDeliveryProject

parameters.help_en:
The type of the collected logs. Default value: cdn_log_access_l1. Valid values:

cdn_log_access_l1: access logs of Dynamic Content Delivery Network (DCDN) points of presence (POPs)

cdn_log_origin: back-to-origin logs

cdn_log_er: EdgeRoutine logs

By default, this parameter is left empty, and all logs are returned
parameters.help_zh:
业务类型，取值：

dcdn_log_access_l1（默认值）：用户访问日志。
dcdn_log_er：边缘程序日志。
dcdn_log_waf：WAF拦截日志
parameters.name: business_type

parameters.help_en: The domain name. You can specify only one domain name in each request. If this parameter is not specified, all domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh: 域名，仅支持单个域名查询。不填为空则表示查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Valid values: 1 to 100000. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 第几页，取值范围为：1~100000，默认1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The default value is 20
parameters.name: page_size

Projects.description_en: The configuration results of the domain name

DataCenter.description_en: The region from which logs were collected

DomainName.description_en: The domain names from which logs were collected. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
DomainName.description_zh: 域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）隔开

FieldName.description_en: The name of the field. For more information about fields in real-time log entries, see [Fields in a real-time log]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/324199.html）
FieldName.description_zh: 字段名称。所有字段请参见[实时日志采集字段说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/324199.html）

SLSProject.description_en: The name of the log file

SLSRegion.description_en: The region to which logs were delivered

Type.description_en: The type of log delivery. Only SLS_POST is supported
Type.description_zh: 投递类型，目前仅支持SLS_POST（SLS投递）

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
